findings.text: The iPhone add-to-Home-Screen steps end with "Tap Allow one notification a week, then Allow" (public/join/copy.js:63), but an iOS Home Screen app has its own cookie jar, separate from Safari. A person who opens it from the Home Screen is signed out and sees Continue with Google first. Say "sign in again, then tap Allow" (and check that GIS/FedCM signs in inside the standalone app). Otherwise the iOS half of the owner's "sign in, then turn on notifications" ask breaks at its last step.

A Copy link or Share in the in-app card copies `location.href` (public/join/Join.js:471). In test mode that URL carries `?test=<TEST_LOGIN_KEY>`, so sharing the page from a test session publishes the staging test key. Strip the `test` param from the shared URL.

That happens on any stage where `/api` answers but `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` is empty (production today). The result is a TypeError, not a sign-in. `Backend.detect()` could fall back to the mock when `client_id` is empty.

`Reset everything` runs `localStorage.clear()` (Join.js:550), which wipes every app's local state on staging.lew42.com, not only /join/'s keys (`join-mock`, `join-google-email`). Debug only, but worth narrowing.
